raw_segments.text: They laughed and could not stop themselves, and not scornfully, but kindly and merrily.
They all felt friendly to me at once, even those who had been sternest in their censure,
and all the following month before my discharge came, they could not make enough of me.
Ah, you monk! they would say.
And every one said something kind to me, they began trying to dissuade me, even to pity
What are you doing to yourself?
